scope: Independent remote agent pilot two against the anonymous public preview, using own CUA in-app browser tabs; valueless TEST only. This is not human usability research or a completed release claim.
flow: Public homepage -> network identity -> playground -> disposable wallet -> one faucet claim -> NFT issuance -> second disposable wallet in separate tab -> NFT transfer -> gallery current-owner lookup -> explorer receipt -> direct explorer refresh.

environment.browserSkillAvailability: Browser plugin skill absent; CUA available and used as requested
environment.tabs: Two new pilot-owned tabs, sender and recipient

wallets.secrets: App generated memory-only disposable wallets. No user key import or secret inspection.
wallets.lossDisclosureObserved: Create a disposable wallet to get started. Reloading this page loses access to it.
wallets.reloadLossEvidence: Recipient tab reload restored Create test wallet, blank balance and disabled faucet/mint controls. The former public key and transfer controls disappeared. Both disposable wallet accesses were intentionally lost by reload at the end of testing.

issuance.name: Pilot Two Orbit
issuance.observedState: Issued and verified on the experimental network.

transfer.directExplorerRefresh: Receipt returned successfully on the exact deep URL after reload, showing Confirmed, slot 4904 and fee 0.000005 TEST.

checks.pageIdentity: pass: Solana Classic — Memes & NFTs; intended public URLs
checks.notBlank: pass: meaningful home, network, playground, gallery and explorer content
checks.consoleHealth: pass: no captured warnings or errors in sender tab
checks.screenshots: Desktop playground and explorer; 360 px gallery current-owner state and playground visible focus were emitted through CUA. No screenshot file was written.
checks.interactionProof: pass: one faucet grant, one verified NFT issuance, one NFT transfer and matching gallery owner
checks.mobileKeyboardFocus: pass: Tab from Name focused Symbol with visible purple focus outline
checks.memoryOnlyWalletLoss: pass: recipient reload removed wallet access as disclosed

limitations: Agent pilot, not human usability research.
The explorer displayed Confirmed; this report does not reinterpret that label as a separate finalization assertion.
NFT flow only; the other independent pilot covers meme issuance and transfer.
No claim about soak, performance, provider recovery, backups or complete release acceptance.
Mobile checks were limited to gallery overflow and playground layout/focus, not a full accessibility audit.
No production economic value, mainnet or bridge action was performed.
